role.title: Senior Functional Consultant
role.role_basis: O*NET 15-1211.00 Computer Systems Analysts / ESCO 'ICT application configurator' occupation (senior functional-consultant profile)
role.context_note: Currently a Functional Consultant Level 3 (software consultancy, 4-7 yrs; software/product knowledge, configuration troubleshooting, workshop facilitation, mentoring junior consultants); growing into cross-functional expertise, solution design leadership, trusted advisory, solution evaluation -- a level 3-to-4 progression within the same track. role_title cleaned from their literal Q9 answer "Functional Consultant Level 4" (an internal grade, not an external job-ad title) into a standard seniority label.

courses.title: Becoming a Trusted Advisor
courses.description: Becoming a Trusted Advisor focuses on trusted advisory for people working toward a Senior Functional Consultant role, through hands-on exercises and short review checkpoints. It also introduces workshop facilitation, enough to apply alongside trusted advisory in real Senior Functional Consultant work. By the end, you'll be able to explain your approach to trusted advisory and show how workshop facilitation supports it.
learning_outcomes: Applying trusted advisory to a real Senior Functional Consultant scenario
Practicing trusted advisory through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to workshop facilitation
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Solution Evaluation for Practitioners
courses.description: Solution Evaluation for Practitioners goes beyond the basics of solution evaluation, for people already working toward a Senior Functional Consultant role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in solution evaluation and want to go further.

courses.description: Requirements Gathering Basics is a short introduction to requirements gathering for people moving toward a Senior Functional Consultant role. You'll walk through the essential vocabulary and a few guided exercises that show requirements gathering in context, with no prior experience assumed. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if requirements gathering is new to you.

alternates.title: Trusted Advisory Essentials
alternates.description: Trusted Advisory Essentials walks you through the basics of trusted advisory, built for people new to Senior Functional Consultant work. Starting from the essential vocabulary, you'll work through a handful of guided exercises that build a working sense of trusted advisory, with no prior experience assumed. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.
learning_outcomes: Applying trusted advisory to a real Senior Functional Consultant scenario
Practicing trusted advisory through guided exercises
Building a short trusted advisory exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them
